name: Ledge Grab
description: Catches an edge the character is falling past and hangs there until the player climbs or drops. Detection is the two-probe test: something at hand height is solid and nothing at head height is, which is what distinguishes a ledge from a wall. regrabCooldownSeconds exists because without it, dropping from a ledge re-satisfies the grab test on the very next frame and the character is stuck to it forever.

inputs.name: grabReach
inputs.description: Forward reach of the hand and head probes.

inputs.name: hangHeightOffset
inputs.description: Where the character settles relative to the ledge lip. Negative hangs below it.

inputs.name: climbDurationSeconds
inputs.description: How long the climb takes. The character is not simulated during it, so a long value is a long window of no control.

inputs.name: regrabCooldownSeconds
inputs.description: How long after releasing a ledge before any ledge can be grabbed again.

inputs.name: requiresAirborne
inputs.description: Whether the character must be off the ground to grab. False lets a character standing beside a waist-high edge snap onto it, which is rarely wanted.

inputs.name: autoClimb
inputs.description: False hangs and waits for input. True climbs on contact, which removes the hang entirely — the two are different mechanics wearing one name, so this is the switch between them.
